newsitem.title: USA: Digital Biometrics fiscal Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Digital Biometrics fiscal Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Digital Biometrics Inc on Friday said its loss for its fiscal fourth quarter widened to $3.9 million from $2.3 million in the year-earlier period, partly because of higher interest expense.
Sales in the three months ended September 30 jumped more than threefold to $3.5 million from $1.1 million.
The company, which makes identification systems, said interest expense rose to $83,559 from $26,350 in the period.

Additionally, depreciation and amortization costs included a fourth-quarter write-off of $549,000 for unamortized software of information systems products no longer actively marketed, Digital Biometrics said.
Its stock closed down 1/16 to 2-3/4 in trading on the Nasdaq.
